description: 005-127 (wave 30, form C): form B (primer-minimal) and, after its first sentence, two rules: do not run the tests yourself to learn whether an edit broke something; before you say you are done, `squeal status --wait 60000` gives the verdict. The same switch as primer-minimal, set to `minimal-rules`. Runs only against a build with the switch (the experiment branch exp/minimal-primer).
